tools.name: underchat_list_chats
tools.description: List conversations in one state (my_chats = the executor's own chats; or queue, in_chat, closed, and so on), with optional filters. GET /chat.

tools.name: underchat_search_chats
tools.description: Search conversations by contact name or phone. GET /chat/search.

tools.name: underchat_get_chat_messages
tools.description: Read the message history of one chat, newest first, with paging. GET /chat/{chat_id}.

tools.name: underchat_search_chat_messages
tools.description: Search the messages of one chat for a text. GET /chat/{chat_id}/search.

tools.name: underchat_get_chat_details
tools.description: Get one chat with its state, assigned channel, user, sector and labels. GET /chat/{chat_id}/details.

tools.name: underchat_get_unread_summary
tools.description: Count the unread messages for the executor. GET /chat/unread-summary.

tools.name: underchat_list_channels
tools.description: List the account's channels (for example WhatsApp numbers) with their status. Use the ids as channel or worker ids in other tools. GET /chat/channels-status.

tools.name: underchat_list_workers
tools.description: List the workers (channels) that can receive or transfer a chat, for filters and transfers. GET /chat/workers.

tools.name: underchat_list_contacts
tools.description: List the account's chat contacts with paging and filters. GET /chat/contacts.

tools.name: underchat_get_contact
tools.description: Get one chat contact by id. GET /chat/contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: underchat_find_contact_by_phone
tools.description: Find the chat contact that has a phone number. GET /chat/contacts/by-phone.

tools.name: underchat_list_label_templates
tools.description: List the label templates (etiquetas) of the account. GET /label-template.

tools.name: underchat_list_sectors
tools.description: List the sectors (setores) of the account. GET /sector.

tools.name: underchat_list_users
tools.description: List the users (attendants) of the account with paging and filters. GET /user.

tools.name: underchat_get_user
tools.description: Get one user of the account by id, with the status and access group. GET /user/{user_id}.

tools.name: underchat_send_text_message
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp text message into an existing chat, as the executor. The customer receives it. POST /chat/{chat_id} with type=text.

tools.name: underchat_update_chat_status
tools.description: Move a chat to another state, for example closed, queue or in_chat. Closing ends the attendance for the customer. PATCH /chat/{chat_id}/status.

tools.name: underchat_transfer_chat
tools.description: Transfer a chat to another worker (channel), user or sector. Set at least one of worker_id, user_id or sector_id. POST /chat/{chat_id}/transfer.

tools.name: underchat_set_chat_labels
tools.description: Send a list of label template ids to a chat. The API decides whether the list replaces or adds to the current labels; check the chat after the call. PATCH /chat/{chat_id}/label.

tools.name: underchat_create_contact
tools.description: Create a chat contact with a name and a phone number. POST /chat/contacts.

tools.name: underchat_update_contact
tools.description: Change the fields you send for one chat contact. Fields you omit stay as they are. PATCH /chat/contacts/{contact_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: underchat_list_chats, underchat_search_chats, underchat_get_chat_messages, underchat_search_chat_messages, underchat_get_chat_details, underchat_get_unread_summary, underchat_list_channels, underchat_list_workers, underchat_list_contacts, underchat_get_contact, underchat_find_contact_by_phone, underchat_set_chat_labels · Private data: underchat_search_chats, underchat_list_contacts, underchat_get_contact, underchat_find_contact_by_phone, underchat_create_contact, underchat_update_contact · Public sink: underchat_send_text_message, underchat_transfer_chat, underchat_set_chat_labels, underchat_create_contact, underchat_update_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: underchat_list_chats, underchat_search_chats, underchat_get_chat_messages, underchat_search_chat_messages, underchat_get_chat_details, underchat_get_unread_summary, underchat_list_channels, underchat_list_workers, underchat_list_contacts, underchat_get_contact, underchat_find_contact_by_phone, underchat_set_chat_labels · Private data: underchat_search_chats, underchat_list_contacts, underchat_get_contact, underchat_find_contact_by_phone, underchat_create_contact, underchat_update_contact · Public sink: underchat_send_text_message, underchat_transfer_chat, underchat_set_chat_labels, underchat_create_contact, underchat_update_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
